title: Contract Elongation Sentinel: Executive Escalation & Mitigation Playbook
body:
Purpose:
Provide a compact, operational playbook for detecting early signs of contract non-elongation (renewal failure) and executing a calibrated mitigation + executive escalation. This doc is intentionally short-form and actionable for CS reps, AMs, and the SLA escalation chain.

Scope:
- Applies to mid-market and enterprise accounts with renewals in the next 90–180 days.
- Focus on first-response (0–72h), stabilization (72h–30d), and executive engagement (30d+) phases.
- Not intended for churn post-cancellation remediation (see cancellation-retention-playbook).

How to use this doc (quick):
1) Score the account with the Renewal Sentinel Score (RSS) below.
2) If RSS >= 7, start Rapid Response workflow and notify Tier-1 Exec (AE lead / CSM manager).
3) If RSS >= 12, open Exec Escalation channel and prepare the Exec Brief template.
4) Track interventions in JIRA-CS-XXX and update the QBR tracker row.

Signal taxonomy (signals we look for):
- Usage signals: 25%+ drop in monthly API tokens or active users vs trailing 3mo baseline.
- Feature adoption: primary feature flakiness or non-adoption (e.g., routing to fallback model > 15% of calls).
- Support friction: 3+ Sev2 incidents or >8 P1/P2 tickets open in last 60 days.
- Financial: invoices disputed, PO delays, procurement delays >30d.
- Strategic: competing PoC disclosed, product roadmap misalignment, hiring freeze.
- Sentiment: NPS dropped by >=10 points since last QBR or negative language in executive comms.

Renewal Sentinel Score (RSS) - quick formula:
- Usage drop: 0/2/4 (none/moderate/major)
- Feature adoption: 0/1/3
- Support friction: 0/2/4
- Financial friction: 0/3/5
- Strategic threat: 0/2/4
- Executive sentiment: 0/2/4
Interpretation: 0–4 low risk, 5–8 medium, 9–14 high, 15+ critical.
Example: 30% usage drop (4) + 1 adoption gap (1) + 2 P2s (2) + PO delay (3) = RSS 10 -> high.

Failure-mode matrix (what can go wrong + immediate mitigation):
- Failure: Application latency due to model mismatch -> Mitigation: Roll back to verified model variant; enable prefix caching; open incident bridge with SRE; notify customer in 1h.
- Failure: Billing dispute -> Mitigation: Pause auto-charge; engage Finance CS liaison; provide line-item export; arrange payment schedule; escalate to Sales Ops.
- Failure: Executive concern about roadmap fit -> Mitigation: Quick wins doc + 2-week action plan; schedule executive-to-executive alignment meeting; propose pilot with dedicated capacity.

Rapid Response play types (pick 1–2 and sequence):
1) Technical Save (TT): immediate reliability/fix-first, 48h stabilization. Owners: CSM + SRE + Applied ML.
2) Value Reminder (VR): product usage rehab + success plan, 7–30d. Owners: CSM + Solutions Eng.
3) Commercial Reset (CR): pricing/contract adjustments + finance runway, 14–45d. Owners: AE + Finance + CSM.
4) Exec Alignment (EA): executive-level meeting + joint roadmap, 30–90d. Owners: VP CS + Customer Exec Sponsor.

Escalation ladder (who to call and when):
- RSS 5–8 (medium) -> Notify CSM manager, schedule internal triage within 48h.
- RSS 9–11 (high) -> Add AE, Solutions Eng, and Sales Ops to triage; prepare 1-page impact memo for VP CS.
- RSS 12–14 (very high) -> Tier-1 Exec escalation: VP CS (for executive outreach) + Director of Applied ML (technical commit).
- RSS 15+ (critical) -> Tier-2 Exec: CRO + CTO tabletop; reserve dedicated meeting slot within 72h.

Executive Brief (one-page template - fill in):
- Account name:
- ARR at renewal:
- Renewal date / days to renewal:
- RSS score and top 3 signals:
- Immediate customer asks (bullet):
- Proposed play(s) & owners (who will do what and by when):
- Ask from Execs (decisions / approve credit / commit HT resource):
- Escalation timeline and next check-in date:

Customer outreach scripts (CSM -> initial):
- Subject: Quick sync on upcoming renewal and usage
- Body starter: "Hi <Name>, noticed some drop-off in usage and a few open tickets — want to make sure we’re aligned and remove any blockers ahead of renewal. Can you share 30 mins this week?"
- If financial: "We can pause invoicing while we sort procurement — want to avoid service disruption. Can we connect Finance teams?"

Operational checklist (first 72 hours):
- [ ] Create JIRA-CS ticket and link to renewal row in tracker
- [ ] Run token/usage delta report and attach screenshots
- [ ] Export top 10 error traces and triage with SRE
- [ ] Confirm procurement status with AE
- [ ] Draft Exec Brief and circulate to VP CS for signoff
- [ ] Set up customer bridge if Sev2/P1 exists

Metrics to monitor during mitigation:
- weekly active users (WAU) and token consumption (report weekly)
- time to resolution for open incidents (target <72h for Sev2)
- engagement velocity (number of strategic meetings scheduled in 30d)
- invoice clearance days (target <14d after remediation)

Save play examples (short case notes):
- Case A: Mid-market fintech — usage down 40% after a model change; Solution: rollback + dedicated SE triage + two-week caching configuration -> renewal regained after 6 weeks.
- Case B: Enterprise retail — procurement inertia + PO dispute; Solution: short-term credit + multi-party call w/ finance + PO escalation to CRO -> contract extended with 6-month staged payments.

Decision heuristics for concessions (avoid ad hoc giveaways):
- Always tie concessions to a measurable outcome (usage increase, NPS recovery, run-rate target).
- Small credits (<5% ARR) can be approved by CSM manager; >5% requires AE + Sales Ops sign-off; persistent >15% needs VP approval.

Communication collateral (templates):
- One-page "Recovery Plan" PDF (attach to exec brief)
- 2-slide "Immediate Fix + 30-day Plan" for exec meetings
- Shared spreadsheet: renewal tracker row with interventions and dates

Open questions / notes to self:
- Need a quick-run query that surfaces accounts with concurrent signals (usage drop + PO delay) — ask Analytics for a weekly feed.
- Define SLAs for action owners (SRE triage within 2h for Sev1, applied-ml response within 12h for model regressions).
- Consider an automated Slack alert for RSS >= 9.

Appendix: quick links and artifacts:
- Link to QBR tracker (sheet): drive://shared_drives/customer-success/qbr-renewal-tracker-2026.xlsx
- Example exec brief (redacted): drive://shared_drives/customer-success/examples/exec-brief-retail-q4-2025.pdf

Notes: rough / draft — encourage peers to add play snippets from recent saves. This file should live alongside the QBR tracker row and be referenced in weekly CS huddles.
summary: Compact CS playbook for detecting renewal risk, scoring accounts, triaging, and escalating to execs. Includes RSS formula, failure-mode matrix, checklist, scripts, and decision heuristics.
